grants.description: Verify your identity using your GOV.UK One Login credentials
grants.purpose: To confirm you are who you say you are and link to your immigration records

grants.description: Check your immigration status and ILR grant date
grants.purpose: To verify you hold valid ILR and meet the 12-month requirement

grants.description: Access your UK residence history for the past 5 years
grants.purpose: To verify you have lived in the UK for the required period

grants.description: Access your travel in and out of the UK for the past 5 years
grants.purpose: To verify you have not exceeded the absence limits (450 days in 5 years, 90 days in final year)

grants.description: Share your English language qualification or test results
grants.purpose: To verify you meet the English language requirement at B1 level or above

grants.description: Share your Life in the UK test results
grants.purpose: To verify you have passed the Life in the UK test

grants.description: Conduct a criminal record check for good character assessment
grants.purpose: To assess whether you meet the good character requirement for British citizenship

grants.description: Provide details of two referees who have known you for at least 3 years
grants.purpose: Home Office will contact your referees to verify your identity and good character

grants.description: Upload supporting documents including passport, BRP, marriage certificate (if applicable)
grants.purpose: To verify your identity, residency, and eligibility for British citizenship

revocation.mechanism: Contact Home Office or revoke through your GOV.UK account before decision is made
revocation.effect: Application will be withdrawn and fee may not be refundable. You can reapply later.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot make payment on your behalf. Agent cannot provide or contact referees. Agent cannot upload documents without your explicit approval of each document. Agent cannot book citizenship ceremony. Agent cannot make statements about your character or criminal record.
